thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Spike in cross-region 5xx and latency for APAC -> EU requests. Metric: cross_region_error_rate > 5% for 3m. Investigate.

jamie-sre: seeing the same on the routing dashboard — APAC clients are getting EU pinned endpoints, latency +350ms and tail 5xxs.

rui-oncall: paging @sasha-netops and @chris-eng. I'm on-call and looking now. Any recent policy changes?

sasha-netops: I pushed a region-pin policy promotion earlier (promo ID rp-2026-04-03) around 4381229000. It was a mass promotion to standardize pinning behavior for new geofences. Rolling that back now to test.

chris-eng: confirming — deployment logs show rp-2026-04-03 applied to EU and NA steering groups at 4381229123. It included a fallback that preferred EU for unknown APAC ASN ranges.

alex-support: customers reporting timeouts from APAC app endpoints in the last ~10m, some support tickets opened (CS-4121, CS-4122). Impact looks like degraded UX, not full outages.

rui-oncall: ok rollback in-flight. Sasha, can you apply an immediate pin override to map APAC -> nearest apac pool and force TTL low? We want quick drain.

sasha-netops: doing pin override now:```
# temp pin override
redwood route pin set --region apac --force --scope global --reason "emerg rollback rp-2026"
```
Applying...

deploy-bot: rollbacks started for promo rp-2026-04-03 (jobs: deploy-20321, config-sync). Status: in-progress.

jamie-sre: metrics switching — early signs of improvement for 1xx-4xx ratio but still seeing a burst of cached DNS pointing to EU. Need to TTL-drain DNS caches. Sasha, what's current authoritative TTL?

sasha-netops: TTL was 300s; setting to 30s for affected prefixes. Running DNS push to APAC authoritative now.

meera-pd: alerting PagerDuty stakeholders and APAC account reps. Notifying top-tier customers about mitigation steps.

chris-eng: adding a temporary routing rule to prefer apac pools at the edge for clients seen from APAC ASNs — this is a local override at the LB layer. Will hold for 15m then reassess.```

sasha-netops: LB override applied to edge clusters apac-01..apac-04. Verifying convergence.

jamie-sre: graphs show median latency APAC->APAC pools dropping from ~420ms to ~90ms after LB override; error rate trending down from 6.8% -> 1.2% over 2 minutes. Good.

alex-support: updating ticket queue: "We identified an unintended region-pin promotion causing APAC traffic to be steered to EU. Rollback and DNS TTL drain in progress. Expect restoration within 5-10m."

rui-oncall: handoff note for next on-call in 20m: follow DNS TTL until fully converged, keep pin override for 15m post-convergence, then remove and monitor. I'll post a concise incident summary once stable.

meera-pd: coordinating with account teams — one enterprise customer had <5% requests with errors. No data exfiltration, no increased error budget breaches so far.

chris-eng: root cause looks like promo logic didn’t account for legacy ASN mappings for certain APAC ISPs — condition matched as "unknown" and fallback favored EU. I'll open PR to add explicit ASN whitelist checks and unit tests.

jamie-sre: can we capture a sample of affected requests for postmortem analysis? Need headers + egress path (no PII). Sasha, can you dump 5m of routing traces to s3 with restricted access?

sasha-netops: started trace export: s3://redwood-incidents/4381234567/traces.tar.gz (access limited). Saved 1200 traces.

deploy-bot: rollback rp-2026-04-03 complete. All promo artifacts reverted.

jamie-sre: observed final stabilization at 4381234580; error rate under 0.5% across regions. Good cleanup.

rui-oncall: marking incident as mitigated. Will keep pinned overrides and TTL low until 4381235400 (15m) then remove. Assign postmortem owners: chris-eng (root cause), sasha-netops (mitigation timeline), jamie-sre (timeline & monitoring gaps).

meera-pd: notifying customers and sales teams with final summary in 10m.

alex-support: leaving notes on impacted tickets and tagging for follow-up.

chris-eng: created issue RG-5892: "region-pin promo: ASN fallback misclassifies APAC leading to cross-region misroute". I'll attach traces and test plan.

rui-oncall: quick retrospective: need canary criteria tightened (ASN coverage) and a safeguard to block promos that change fallback region for >1% traffic without manual runway. Adding to postmortem action items.

jamie-sre: agreed. Also add an alert for sudden TTL-mismatch between edge and authoritative DNS after routing promos.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated by operator actions. Summary: misapplied region-pin promo caused APAC->EU misroutes. Rollback + LB override + DNS TTL drain restored correct routing. Follow-ups assigned: RG-5892, postmortem scheduled.

rui-oncall: handing off to night on-call @meera-pd in case of recurrence; full postmortem to be posted by EOD.

meera-pd: taking handoff. Thanks everyone for quick coordination. :thumbsup:
